sentences: Measured natively on an AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics RDNA2 GPU (`gfx1036`, not the console's `gfx1013`; Windows driver 32.0.21042.62, `tools/hw_oracle`, wave32 and wave64 identical on every case: 256 seeded triples across 4 MODEs plus 73 targeted special-case/modifier rows, 0 mismatches).

Computes `div_fixup_f32(S0=quotient, S1=denom, S2=numer)` with pure integer SPIR-V ops under the game's inferred MODE (`IEEE=0`, `denorm32=0`, `DX10_CLAMP=1`): VOP3 `abs` (clear bit 31) then `neg` (flip bit 31) apply bitwise to `S0`/`S1`/`S2` before classification (including NaN payloads); `S1`/`S2` subnormals flush to signed zero (`exp == 0`) while `S0` subnormals are preserved; priority order is (1) `NaN(S2) → S2`, (2) `NaN(S1) → S1` (signalling NaNs pass unchanged under `IEEE=0`, quieted only when `IEEE=1`), (3) `0/0` or `±inf/±inf → 0xFFC00000` (`-qNaN`), (4) `zero(S2) ∨ inf(S1) → ±0.0`, (5) `zero(S1) ∨ inf(S2) → ±inf`, (6) `exp(S2) − exp(S1) ≤ −151 → ±0.0` (pure biased-exponent check, beats `NaN(S0)` and `inf(S0)`; no overflow check), (7) `NaN(S0) → ±inf`, (8) `copysign(S0, sign(S1) ⊕ sign(S2))`.
Output modifiers `mul:2`/`mul:4`/`div:2` apply before `clamp`, and `clamp` maps NaN to `+0.0` (`DX10_CLAMP=1`) before `FClamp` to `[0, 1]`.
Not modelled: `IEEE=1` sNaN quieting, `denorm32=3` keeping `S1`/`S2` subnormals, and the hardware `omod` `-0 → +0` quirk (same as the other f32 ops).
Checked bit-for-bit against 73 measured `gfx1036` words in `tests/semantic/test_alu_div_fixup_f32.py`.
